subject: general
question: How many times have the Asian Games been held in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Two**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Two** times the Asian Games have been held in India.
 
• The first time was in **1951** in New Delhi.
 
• The second time was in **1982** also in New Delhi.
 
• India is one of the few countries to have hosted the Asian Games more than once.
 
• The 1951 Asian Games were the inaugural edition of the event.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Asian Games, also known as Asiad, is a continental multi-sport event held every four years among athletes from all over Asia.
 
• The Games were regulated by the Asian Games Federation (AGF) from the first Games in New Delhi, India until the 1978 Games.
 
• Since the 1982 Games, they have been organized by the Olympic Council of Asia (OCA), after the breakup of the Asian Games Federation.
 
• The Games are recognized by the International Olympic Committee (IOC) and are described as the second largest multi-sport event after the Olympic Games.
